newsitem.title: USA: LSI Logic buys Mint Technology for undisclosed sum.
newsitem.headline: LSI Logic buys Mint Technology for undisclosed sum.

text.p: LSI Logic Corp., beefing up its engineering services expertise, bought closely held Mint Technology Inc. on Thursday for an undisclosed sum.
Mint Technology, based in Billerica, Mass., provides electrical engineering services to semiconductor companies to help them speed up the development of computer chips.
The acquisition would help LSI -- which makes custom chips for PC makers and consumer electronic companies -- more rapidly develop chips for its customers, the companies said.
LSI, based in Milpitas, California, did not disclose terms of the transaction.
Mint Technology will become a unit of LSI.
